players.name: Josh Allen
notes: The Keep #1 · average 1.6 across 10 Superflex boards
The Board #1 on the long proprietary aggregate
Redraft PPR #27 (Yates 28, FantasyPros 26)
Redraft Standard #27
plus: Seven-board Superflex lock: Keep #1, average 2.0.
Dual-threat floor still separates him from every other aging QB1.
minus: Turns 31 in 2026 — first real dynasty age tax on a perennial 1.01.
Yates PPR has him in the late 20s; 1QB redraft does not pay the SF premium.
grafs: Josh Allen is still the player Ball Keep is built around. Seven sources — PFN, Dynasty Nerds, FantasyPros, KeepTradeCut, and the three X experts we track — all have him inside the top four Superflex assets, and the average lands at 2.0. That is not a recency spike. It is the market admitting that a quarterback who runs, extends, and finishes in the end zone is the safest way to keep a Superflex roster relevant through 2029.

The 2025 tape is the same argument on film: launch-point throws and designed keepers, with the Bills still built to let him create when protection breaks. Redraft boards (Field Yates has him in the high 20s) treat him as a mid QB1 because 1QB leagues do not have to pay the second-starter tax. Dynasty Superflex does. That split is the whole point of The Keep.

The minus is honest: he will be 31 this season, and the first time a 23-year-old passer (Maye) outranks him on a short list, the age conversation gets louder. We are not selling the 1.01 for that. We are naming it. If you are rebuilding past 2028, Maye is the bet. If you are trying to win the next two title windows, Allen is still the chip you do not put in a trade calculator for fun.

Three of our short expert lists (FantasyPros ECR, Andrew Erickson, Pat Fitzmaurice) rank him the Superflex 1.01, Derek Brown has him second, and the long boards (PFN, Dynasty Nerds) park him third behind only Allen. The Keep average is 2.43. That is a 23-year-old passer being priced like a finished product.

The 2025 film is why. The Can't-Miss clip we embedded is the AFC run in miniature: Maye dropping a touchdown and a receiver finishing like a superhero. New England's offense finally looks like a place where a long-striding quarterback can push the ball and scramble without the supporting cast being a weekly apology. Superflex managers who waited on the 2024 draft capital got paid.

The pushback is KeepTradeCut at six and redraft boards that still treat him as a high-end QB2 in 1QB. That is useful. It means you can still find a manager who thinks Allen/Lamar/Hurts are 'safer' and will overpay in picks to move down. Ball Keep's stance: the experts have moved. The startup ADP will follow. Do not be the last one holding the 2024 'he might be Caleb-tier' take.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Konnor Griffin
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Post-deadline dynasty add #1. 19-year-old shortstop the TDG board already has inside the overall 30.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Jesús Made
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: The model and the prospect lists still agree: stash the 19-year-old if he is free.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Walker Jenkins
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Closer to his peak than Made; RotoGraphs has him just ahead. Rebuilds should not be choosing between them on waivers.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Kevin McGonigle
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: The Tigers kid the model stuffed. If he is still sitting, that is a process error.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Sal Stewart
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: RotoGraphs 12th overall. If your league is asleep, this is the buy.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Nick Kurtz
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Thumb ding in the model. The talent is still a top-15 dynasty 1B. Stash the IL.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Cam Schlittler
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: The pitching-nut add. TDG has him ahead of half the veteran aces.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Chase Burns
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Age-23 arm the Pitcher List crowd is stuffing. Dynasty only.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Roman Anthony
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Boston's young outfield bat. Hold through the September noise.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: JJ Wetherholt
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Middle-infield prospect the long boards have inside the 60.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Carson Benge
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Mets outfield flyer. Cheap if your league still treats him as a name.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Samuel Basallo
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Catcher who is not a zero in dynasty. Rare.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Payton Tolle
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Young Red Sox arm. Stash, do not stream.

bb_waivers_dynasty.name: Colt Emerson
bb_waivers_dynasty.why: Mariners shortstop prospect. Deep-league only, still a Keep-adjacent name.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Tanner Scott
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Diaz is leaking. Scott has the Dodger ninth on ESPN's chart. Saves leagues start here.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Jordan Romano
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Three saves in a week. Ugly team, real job. Stream the ninth.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Grant Taylor
bb_waivers_redraft.why: White Sox closer climbing the FantasyPros chart. Available in too many 12-teamers.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Jacob Webb
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Cubs ninth after Palencia's IL. Priority add in saves.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Yoendrys Gomez
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Twins saves. Not a committee you ignore in September.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Riley O'Brien
bb_waivers_redraft.why: If he was dropped after a quiet week, grab him back. 30-save pace.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Louis Varland
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Blue Jays ninth. SV+H monster even if the closer label wobbles.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Pete Fairbanks
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Marlins saves are still saves. Streaming weeks matter more than team quality now.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Cam Schlittler
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Best two-start / rest-of-season streaming ace who is not locked everywhere.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Drew Rasmussen
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Rays innings. Stream him until he proves you shouldn't.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Parker Messick
bb_waivers_redraft.why: September starter you can stream twice. Ratios over wins.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Nolan McLean
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Mets arm with enough Ks to start in a 12-team this week.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Gavin Williams
bb_waivers_redraft.why: The other Cleveland stream. Two-start weeks first.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Eury Pérez
bb_waivers_redraft.why: If he is healthy and free, he is not a stream, he is a roster.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Chase Burns
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Redraft managers still treating him like a prospect. He can help this month.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Andy Pages
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Dodger playing-time bat. Run this week, not next year.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Daylen Lile
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Hot bat the model noticed. Stream outfield if you are chasing average.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Alec Burleson
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Cardinals counting stats. Boring, useful, available.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Ceddanne Rafaela
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Steals + runs in a playoff push. Redraft candy.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Tyler Soderstrom
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Power stream at 1B/OF. Athletics lineup still scores enough.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Jonathan Aranda
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Rays first base. If Kurtz owners need a fill-in, start here.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Ben Rice
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Yankees catcher/1B eligibility. September volume.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Hunter Goodman
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Coors catcher. Ugly ratios around him, real counting stats.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Drake Baldwin
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Braves catcher stream if your C is cold.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Maikel Garcia
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Steals stream. Do not overthink the batting average.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Brice Turang
bb_waivers_redraft.why: If he is free, you need speed. That is the whole note.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Otto Lopez
bb_waivers_redraft.why: The RotoGraphs overperformer. Stream the average.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Miguel Vargas
bb_waivers_redraft.why: White Sox corner bat. Available, hitting enough.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Wilyer Abreu
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Boston outfield. Play the home stand.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Randy Arozarena
bb_waivers_redraft.why: If someone cut him after a cold week, that is a gift.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Jo Adell
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Power stream. Ignore the team, take the homers.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Heliot Ramos
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Giants outfield counting stats for the stretch.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Dylan Lee
bb_waivers_redraft.why: SV+H gold. Holds leagues bump him 10 spots.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Kevin Kelly
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Rays setup. Must-roster in holds, streaming in saves if Baker sits.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Tyler Rogers
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Submarine holds. The boring add that wins categories.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Hunter Gaddis
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Cleveland setup behind Cade Smith. SV+H staple.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Adrian Morejon
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Padres setup. Miller gets saves; Morejon gets the rest.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Alex Vesia
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Dodger lefty. Holds plus the Diaz/Scott mess.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Jeremiah Estrada
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Strikeout reliever. Ratios leagues, not just SV+H.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Garrett Cleavinger
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Rays bullpen is a factory. Roster two of them if you can.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Jac Caglianone
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Young bat with enough September at-bats to stream.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Colson Montgomery
bb_waivers_redraft.why: White Sox shortstop. Deep 12s and 15s only.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Xavier Edwards
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Steals stream. Average is the tax.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Chandler Simpson
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Speed-only stream. You know what you are doing.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Casey Mize
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Two-start filler. Check the matchup, then go.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Nick Lodolo
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Lefty stream. Great park spots only.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Joe Ryan
bb_waivers_redraft.why: If he hit waivers after one clunker, that is a September mistake.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Spencer Schwellenbach
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Braves starter stream. Ks if the elbow holds.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Cade Horton
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Cubs innings. Deep leagues, two-start weeks.

bb_waivers_redraft.name: Trevor Megill
bb_waivers_redraft.why: Still closing in Milwaukee. If dropped, he is priority 1-adjacent.
